03 About the data+

Monthly, with a longer view.

History from January 2010, where available. Every comparison uses the dates shared by the selected assets.

Prices in perspective.

Inflation uses Indonesia’s monthly consumer price index from the BIS ↗. Adjusted values show purchasing power in the starting month’s rupiah. Missing CPI months are excluded.

Biggest fall is the largest drop from an earlier peak in the selected period, using monthly data and the current measuring reference. Daily falls may be larger.

Stocks, indexes, crypto and currencies use monthly closes from Yahoo Finance ↗. Commodities use monthly averages from the World Bank ↗.

Price movements exclude cash dividends and costs. Indexes and commodities are comparison proxies. Foreign assets are converted from their quote currency into the selected measuring currency. TSMC uses its US-listed ADR. The stock collection is curated; it does not represent historical index membership.
